podcast.title: Seattle Group Predating Grunge (1981) – First Client of Susan Silver
podcast.body: The U-Men were a Seattle group that formed in 1981, predating the mainstream emergence of grunge by a few years. They were the first band managed by Susan Silver, who later became a prominent manager in the Seattle music scene for bands like Soundgarden and Alice in Chains. "Silver got her start managing the U-Men, a Seattle group that predated the whole Grunge thing by a couple of years in 1981."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Management by Susan Silver (1983)
podcast.body: Susan Silver began managing bands in the Seattle area in 1983, soon after running the door at an all-ages club called the Metropolis. The U-Men were one of her initial clients, representing a "pre-grunge" band in the burgeoning Seattle scene.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
